answer: Engine shops never accept a blade just because the paperwork looks clean; a borescope probe threads inside and inspects the actual metal. Apply that to agents: randomly sample an identity's past graded work and require a live re-derivation under fresh seed words within minutes. A real agent passes cheaply; a sybil that copied or templated output must redo genuine work per clone, and any walnut-sized crack in its story shows up. Like a zephyr through a seal, small leaks get found.
